Docs.summary: Contains the pixel data produced by an asynchronous rescale-and-read operation.

remarks.para: An instance is passed to the callback supplied to when a read completes. On failure the callback receives instead.

The result and the pixel data it exposes are only valid for the duration of the callback. To keep the pixels beyond the callback, copy them out with , , , or . Do not store the instance or a span returned by for later use.
